title: Black Clover Director Hypes Season 2’s Biggest Moments
content: Now that the Fall 2026 anime season is finally here, Black Clover is all set for its anticipated return with Season 2. As a Weekly Shonen Jump original written and illustrated by Yuki Tabata, which later transitioned to Jump GIGA, it’s one of the biggest action fantasies of all time.
author: ComicBook

title: 'More Than a Married Couple, But Not Lovers' Manga Resumes from Hiatus
content: Yūki Kanamaru announced on X/Twitter on Thursday that the More Than a Married Couple, But Not Lovers manga will return from its hiatus in this year's December issue of Kadokawa 's Young Ace magazine in November.
author: ANN

title: Topo Gigio's Voice Actor Peppino Mazzullo Dies
content: Mazzullo was perhaps best known for voicing the puppet mouse Topo Gigio , a creation of Maria Perego . Beyond voicing the character in Italy, Mazzullo and Topo Gigio also made appearances on The Ed Sulivan Show starting in 1962, and gained worldwide popularity.
author: ANN

title: Evangelion: Δ Cross Reflections Extended Reality Game Streams Teaser Video
content: Korea-based virtual reality (VR) development studio Pixelity Inc. began streaming on Tuesday a teaser video for Evangelion : Δ Cross Reflections , the first extended reality (XR) game based on the Neon Genesis Evangelion franchise .
author: ANN

title: Tasokare Hotel -Tsubomi- Smartphone Game Ends Service
content: Sales of in-game currency have halted. Players can request refunds until the game ends service. Following the end of service, players will still be able to open the app, but they will not be able to access game content. Tasokare Hotel -Tsubomi- launched in March 2025.
author: ANN

title: The Ramparts of Ice Season 2 Anime Streams English Dub Trailer
content: Netflix began streaming on Thursday an English-dubbed version of the second promotional video for the second season of the television anime of Kōcha Agasawa 's The Ramparts of Ice ( Koori no Jyōheki or Ice Castle Wall ) manga.
author: ANN

title: Hideki Arai's SPUNK! Manga Gets Live-Action Film
content: Manga creator Hideki Arai announced on Thursday that his SPUNK! manga will receive a film adaptation, penned and helmed by Itoshi no Irene and Mentor writer/director Keisuke Yoshida , next fall. The film will also get a crowdfunding page to fund the project.
author: ANN

title: 10 Years Later, Crunchyroll Is Bringing Jujutsu Kaisen Studio’s Biggest Hit to the Big Screen
content: The anime studio behind hits like Jujutsu Kaisen and many more, MAPPA, has become one of the leading anime studios, achieving this through various anime adaptations over the years. However, one of the studio’s biggest original hits was actually an original anime, Yuri On Ice!!! , which debuted in October 2016.
author: ComicBook

title: A Bride's Story Manga Gets New Volume Under New Publisher This Winter
content: The third volume of Kaoru Mori 's Shirley ( Shirley Medison ) manga, the first new volume in 12 years for the manga, announced on Wednesday that the author's A Bride's Story ( Otoyome-Gatari ) manga will have a new volume.
author: ANN
